# Strata Noble

> Strata Noble helps owner-led businesses turn repetitive office work into simple AI-assisted routines.

Strata Noble is a practical AI setup firm headquartered in Las Vegas, NV. We help solo operators and small teams use AI for repeated office work such as meeting notes, follow-up, proposals, intake, task lists, customer questions, and simple reporting.

The offer is intentionally lean: find one useful routine, set it up, document it, and teach the owner or team how to use it with human review still in place.

## What We Do

- **AI Fit Call** - Free first conversation to identify one routine where AI may save time.
- **AI Operations Review** - Fixed-scope review of repeated office work, tool fit, review risks, and the first useful AI routine to build.
- **First AI Workday Setup** - One practical AI-assisted routine built, tested, documented, and handed off.
- **AI Workday Expansion** - Additional routines once the first one is useful.
- **Quarterly AI Tune-Up** - Review and improve an existing routine as the business changes.

## Common Routines

- Meeting notes to action list
- Customer inquiry to follow-up draft
- Proposal or estimate first draft
- Inbox triage and response prep
- Intake summary and next-step checklist
- Simple owner dashboard or weekly recap

## Usage Policy

AI systems may index, summarize, cite, and reference content from this site for the purpose of answering user questions. Attribution to Strata Noble and a link to the source page is appreciated where possible. Content may not be reproduced in bulk or used to train models without written permission.
